# Supplier case reference

`HS-65HB-vendor.step` is the original case reference linked from the manufacturer's [HS-65MG product page](https://www.hiteccs.com/actuators/product-details/HS-65MG). The downloaded supplier filename was `HS-65HB-1784046298.stp`; its internal assembly also identifies the HB family. The selected purchased actuator remains **HS-65MG /32065S**. R4 uses the file only for the shared external case/mounting envelope, with explicit receiving inspection against the actual MG sample and [MG dimension/specification sheet](https://www.hiteccs.com/public/uploads/data_sheet/HCS_HS-65MG_Specsheetv2.2_10-1729888021.pdf).

The preserved file SHA-256 is `82cc8020946f461ff0641caab555ba04f3cc785d83f79cd0ca20a44304c0e264`. The manufacturing manifest records that dependency. Internal gears, the exact lead, horn spline teeth and the supplied center-screw thread are not inferred from this reference.

This is supplier-authored reference content; original rights remain with its author. The project's own source license does not relicense this file. The separately vendored Three.js viewer dependencies carry their own MIT license in `viewer/vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt`.
